note: Reviewed people_id to candidate map for Kentucky. LegiScan people_ids are stable across sessions, so this one file serves both the 2025 and the 2026 Regular Session. Every member of either session appears exactly once: a candidate id where a human confirmed the identity, or null where a human confirmed there is no candidate to map. One seat changed hands between the two sessions. David Yates (people_id 22180) held Senate District 37 through the 2025 session and left in October 2025; Gary Clemons (people_id 26549) holds it in the 2026 session. Each of them is absent from the other session's people file, so a run of either session reports exactly one crosswalk person who is not in its snapshot. That is expected, not a defect.
